combo6.title: Funny Dark Rabbit alone: Perfect Toon World and Mind Scan on turn one
combo6.description: One card, going first. Funny Dark Rabbit places Perfect Toon World from the Deck without activating it, so cards that stop Spell activations can't touch it. Perfect Toon World adds Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage, which mentions Toon World, and Faceless Mage discards itself to place Mind Scan face-up from the Deck. A placed Trap is live at once: your opponent plays with their hand revealed, effects they'd activate by revealing a card in hand can't be activated, and Mind Scan can declare a card name to negate on their turn. Funny Dark Rabbit counts as the Toon monster Mind Scan's negation needs, and Perfect Toon World is the Toon Spell. Rabbit's extra Normal Summon for a monster that mentions Toon World is still unused. Starting hand: Funny Dark Rabbit. Deck needs: Perfect Toon World, Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage, Mind Scan.

combo7.title: Three-card interruption board: Mind Scan, Toon Terror and Animimicat
combo7.description: Three cards, going first. Funny Dark Rabbit places Perfect Toon World, Evil Box summons itself and Sets Toon Terror, Toon Bookmark adds Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage for Mind Scan, and Perfect Toon World adds Animimicat for Rabbit's extra Normal Summon. Animimicat is held on purpose: its Quick Effect works in either player's Main Phase, so on your opponent's turn it can Tribute one of their monsters (you control Toon World) and Special Summon Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Your opponent's turn then runs into Mind Scan's revealed hand and declared name, Toon Terror, Animimicat's Tribute, Evil Box's once-per-turn GY spin, and Perfect Toon World banishing one of your Toon monsters out of the way of each effect, once per monster name. Starting hand: Funny Dark Rabbit, Evil Box, Toon Bookmark. Deck needs: Perfect Toon World, Toon Terror, Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage, Mind Scan, Animimicat, Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon.

combo8.title: Going second: Animimicat Tributes their monster, Blue-Eyes Toon Ultimate Dragon swings for 13,600
combo8.description: Three cards, going second into a board of monsters. Funny Dark Rabbit places Perfect Toon World, which adds Animimicat for Rabbit's extra Normal Summon. Evil Box summons itself and Sets Toon Terror. Animimicat's Quick Effect Tributes one of your opponent's monsters, which neither targets nor destroys, and Special Summons Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Evil Box's Quick Effect then puts the Tributed monster from their GY on the bottom of their Deck. Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon, Animimicat and Funny Dark Rabbit shuffle into the Deck to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Toon Ultimate Dragon (4500 ATK), which lets your Toon monsters attack directly. Evil Box is a Toon monster while Toon World is on the field and has no 'cannot attack this turn' clause, and neither does the Ultimate Dragon. Toon Rollback gives the Ultimate Dragon a second attack, the Ultimate Dragon adds Rollback back from the GY, and the second Rollback goes on Evil Box: 4500 x 2 + 2300 x 2 = 13,600 direct damage through any monsters left on their field. Starting hand: Funny Dark Rabbit, Evil Box, Toon Rollback. Deck needs: Perfect Toon World, Animimicat, Toon Terror, Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon; Blue-Eyes Toon Ultimate Dragon in the Extra Deck.
